status: R5.V1 digital architecture + R5.V3 exact GAL implementation

U2-U4.reason: PDIP ripple counter with 34 MHz guaranteed minimum fMAX at 4.5 V over -40..85 C

U8-U11.reason: fast address selection with TTL-compatible inputs for Z80 and GAL outputs

U12-U15.reason: 91 MHz guaranteed minimum clock rate and TTL-compatible control inputs

U17-U18.reason: TTL-compatible GAL clock/reset and 97 MHz rated clock

U19.reason: 45 MHz rated PDIP shifter; generic HC166 is not guaranteed above the 25.175 MHz dot clock

U20.reason: TTL inputs accept both Z80 and SRAM/GAL levels; CPU path only runs at 2 MHz

U22.reason: TTL inputs accept ALS/GAL highs; gates form two-axis blanking and full-rail H_CLR/V_CLR

U23.reason: three independent 24 mA RGB drivers prevent one gate sourcing all monitor loads

fanout.assessment: within one local oscillator/GAL output load budget; R5.V5 places a 33 ohm series source terminator at oscillator pin 8 and constrains the post-resistor tree

fetch_timing.policy: FETCH owns SRAM for phases 12-15 of each 16-dot byte; shifter load and one-dot BYTE_TICK occur at phase 0; the three-dot budget is deliberately conservative

wait_contract.driver: ATF22V10 pin 14 open-drain emulation: WAIT_N.T=GND, WAIT_N.E=cpu_access*FETCH
wait_contract.ownership: scan owns mux/SRAM and U20 is disabled during FETCH; CPU owns them otherwise
wait_contract.write_rule: WE may assert only outside FETCH after CPU address and D-to-FD direction are selected

reset_contract.U2-U4: RESET_N enters both decode GALs; H_END and V_END are forced asserted during reset, and HCT08 gates drive H_CLR/V_CLR
reset_contract.U17-U18: FRAME_TOP_N from V-decode is forced low while timing chain resets
reset_contract.SRAM: contents undefined at reset; all selects remain inactive unless a valid owner is present

gal_release.horizontal: U5: 0..799 line, 656..751 sync, phases 12..15 FETCH, phase-0 load/tick, dot-640 row strobe
gal_release.vertical: U6: 0..524 frame, 490..491 sync, 0..479 active, odd-line row capture
gal_release.frame_tick: registered self-recovering modulo-six counter; ~25.4 us pulse every sixth 59.94 Hz frame
gal_release.control: U7: D800-FFFF only in modes 0/3; scan priority; open-drain WAIT; SRAM and HCT245 mutually owned
gal_release.retarget: A non-2.000 MHz CPU requires changing the modulo-N next-state/tick equations in video-vdec-u6.pld, rebuilding all artifacts and rerunning the exact oracle plus integrated boot
